proof_summary: The cases \(3^2\) and \(3^3\) are settled by direct minimality checks, while for \(81\) the congruence \(N+\operatorname{rev}(N)\equiv(2+9(\ell-1))S\pmod{81}\) forces any smaller qualifying number to have nine digits of sum \(81\), hence to be all nines. For \(n\ge5\), start with a 19-digit palindrome divisible by \(3^5\) and repeatedly concatenate three copies: each step preserves palindromicity and gains a factor of \(3\), while its length \(19\cdot3^{n-5}<3^{n-2}\) makes it smaller than the all-nines candidate.
